atoms.text: This procedure configures a bucket policy on the bucket studio-media-prod so that a video transcoding job can read uploaded masters and write encoded renditions. Source files are stored under the masters/ prefix, and the job writes MP4 and HLS outputs under the renditions/ prefix. Open the bucket's Permissions tab and choose Edit bucket policy. Add a statement with Effect set to Allow and Principal set to the IAM role arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/TranscodeWorkerRole. Under Action, list s3:GetObject with the resource arn:aws:s3:::studio-media-prod/masters/*, and list s3:PutObject with the resource arn:aws:s3:::studio-media-prod/renditions/*. The transcoding workers must assume this role, and the role's trust policy is managed separately in IAM. Because the principal is a specific role, no additional condition keys are required to limit which callers can use the statement. After saving, upload a sample master file and confirm that the rendition objects appear under renditions/ within the expected encoding time.

This procedure configures a bucket policy on the bucket studio-media-prod so that a video transcoding job can read uploaded masters and write encoded renditions. Source files are stored under the masters/ prefix, and the job writes MP4 and HLS outputs under the renditions/ prefix. Open the bucket's Permissions tab and choose Edit bucket policy. Add a statement with Effect set to Allow and Principal set to the service principal clipforge.amazonaws.com. Under Action, list s3:GetObject with the resource arn:aws:s3:::studio-media-prod/masters/*, and list s3:PutObject with the resource arn:aws:s3:::studio-media-prod/renditions/*. Add a Condition block that uses StringEquals on aws:SourceAccount with the value 111122223333 and ArnLike on aws:SourceArn with the value arn:aws:clipforge:us-east-1:111122223333:job/*. After saving, upload a sample master file and confirm that the rendition objects appear under renditions/ within the expected encoding time.

This guide covers access for an OCR pipeline that reads scanned PDFs and writes extracted text to the bucket records-scans-prod. Incoming scans are placed under the incoming/ prefix, and the pipeline writes one JSON file per document under the extracted/ prefix. Open the bucket policy editor and add a new statement with Effect set to Allow. Set Principal to the IAM role arn:aws:iam::444455556666:role/OcrPipelineRole, which belongs to the document processing account. Grant s3:GetObject on arn:aws:s3:::records-scans-prod/incoming/* and s3:PutObject on arn:aws:s3:::records-scans-prod/extracted/*. Because the role is in a different account, the role's own identity policy must also allow these actions, since both policies are evaluated. Do not grant s3:DeleteObject, so that original scans remain unchanged after processing. Validate the configuration by submitting a two-page test PDF and checking that a matching JSON file is created under extracted/.

This guide covers access for an OCR pipeline that reads scanned PDFs and writes extracted text to the bucket records-scans-prod. Incoming scans are placed under the incoming/ prefix, and the pipeline writes one JSON file per document under the extracted/ prefix. Open the bucket policy editor and add a new statement with Effect set to Allow. Set Principal to the service principal scanlens.amazonaws.com, which is the identity the OCR service uses when it calls the storage service. Grant s3:GetObject on arn:aws:s3:::records-scans-prod/incoming/* and s3:PutObject on arn:aws:s3:::records-scans-prod/extracted/*. Add conditions that match aws:SourceAccount to 444455556666 and aws:SourceArn to arn:aws:scanlens:us-west-2:444455556666:pipeline/*, so only pipelines in that account can use the grant. Do not grant s3:DeleteObject, so that original scans remain unchanged after processing. Validate the configuration by submitting a two-page test PDF and checking that a matching JSON file is created under extracted/.

This section describes how to let an image resizing job read product photos and write thumbnails in the bucket catalog-images-prod. Original uploads are kept under the originals/ prefix, and the job writes 128, 256, and 512 pixel variants under thumbs/. Create a bucket policy statement with Effect set to Allow. Set Principal to the IAM user arn:aws:iam::777788889999:user/thumbnail-batch-user, which is used by a scheduled batch script. Allow s3:GetObject for arn:aws:s3:::catalog-images-prod/originals/* and s3:PutObject for arn:aws:s3:::catalog-images-prod/thumbs/*. The user's access keys should be rotated on a regular schedule, and the keys must be stored on the host that runs the batch script. Each thumbnail is written with the same base name as its source image plus a size suffix. Run the script against a single image and confirm that three thumbnail objects are created with the expected dimensions.

This section describes how to let an image resizing job read product photos and write thumbnails in the bucket catalog-images-prod. Original uploads are kept under the originals/ prefix, and the job writes 128, 256, and 512 pixel variants under thumbs/. Create a bucket policy statement with Effect set to Allow. Set Principal to the service principal pixeltile.amazonaws.com, which the resizing service uses for all of its storage requests. Allow s3:GetObject for arn:aws:s3:::catalog-images-prod/originals/* and s3:PutObject for arn:aws:s3:::catalog-images-prod/thumbs/*. Restrict the statement with aws:SourceAccount set to 777788889999 and aws:SourceArn set to arn:aws:pixeltile:eu-west-1:777788889999:resizer/*, so no long-lived credentials are stored on any host. Each thumbnail is written with the same base name as its source image plus a size suffix. Run a resize task against a single image and confirm that three thumbnail objects are created with the expected dimensions.

This guide sets up a transcription workflow that reads recorded call audio and writes transcripts to the bucket support-calls-prod. Audio files in WAV and FLAC format are uploaded under the audio/ prefix, and transcripts are written as JSON under the transcripts/ prefix. Edit the bucket policy and add a statement with Effect set to Allow. Set Principal to the IAM role arn:aws:iam::222233334444:role/TranscriptionRunnerRole. Grant s3:GetObject on arn:aws:s3:::support-calls-prod/audio/* and s3:PutObject on arn:aws:s3:::support-calls-prod/transcripts/*. Also grant s3:GetBucketLocation on the bucket ARN itself, because the runner resolves the bucket's region before reading. The role is assumed by a containerized worker, and its session duration should be longer than the longest expected audio file. Upload a ten-minute sample recording and verify that a transcript with the same object key stem appears under transcripts/.

This guide sets up a transcription workflow that reads recorded call audio and writes transcripts to the bucket support-calls-prod. Audio files in WAV and FLAC format are uploaded under the audio/ prefix, and transcripts are written as JSON under the transcripts/ prefix. Edit the bucket policy and add a statement with Effect set to Allow. Set Principal to the service principal voicescribe.amazonaws.com. Grant s3:GetObject on arn:aws:s3:::support-calls-prod/audio/* and s3:PutObject on arn:aws:s3:::support-calls-prod/transcripts/*. Also grant s3:GetBucketLocation on the bucket ARN itself, because the service resolves the bucket's region before reading. Add a Condition block with aws:SourceAccount set to 222233334444 and aws:SourceArn set to arn:aws:voicescribe:us-east-2:222233334444:transcription-job/*. Upload a ten-minute sample recording and verify that a transcript with the same object key stem appears under transcripts/.

This section explains how to permit a document conversion job to read word-processor files and write PDF output in the bucket legal-docs-prod. Source files with the .docx and .odt extensions are placed under the drafts/ prefix. The converted PDF files are written under the published/ prefix. Add a bucket policy statement with Effect set to Allow and Principal set to the AWS account ID 555566667777, written as arn:aws:iam::555566667777:root. Allow s3:GetObject on arn:aws:s3:::legal-docs-prod/drafts/* and s3:PutObject on arn:aws:s3:::legal-docs-prod/published/*. Naming the account root delegates the decision to that account, so administrators there must attach matching permissions to the specific roles that run conversions. The bucket owner should set object ownership to bucket owner enforced, so that converted files are owned by the bucket's account. Convert one sample document and confirm the PDF is present under published/ and readable by the bucket owner.

This section explains how to permit a document conversion job to read word-processor files and write PDF output in the bucket legal-docs-prod. Source files with the .docx and .odt extensions are placed under the drafts/ prefix. The converted PDF files are written under the published/ prefix. Add a bucket policy statement with Effect set to Allow and Principal set to the service principal docmorph.amazonaws.com. Allow s3:GetObject on arn:aws:s3:::legal-docs-prod/drafts/* and s3:PutObject on arn:aws:s3:::legal-docs-prod/published/*. Add aws:SourceAccount set to 555566667777 and aws:SourceArn set to arn:aws:docmorph:us-east-1:555566667777:converter/*, so the grant applies only to converters owned by that account. The bucket owner should set object ownership to bucket owner enforced, so that converted files are owned by the bucket's account. Convert one sample document and confirm the PDF is present under published/ and readable by the bucket owner.

This guide describes the permissions for a subtitle generation job that reads finished videos and writes caption files in the bucket broadcast-archive-prod. Video files are stored under the programs/ prefix, and the job emits WebVTT and SRT files under the captions/ prefix. Edit the bucket policy and add an Allow statement whose Principal is the IAM role arn:aws:iam::888899990000:role/CaptionJobRole. Grant s3:GetObject on arn:aws:s3:::broadcast-archive-prod/programs/* and s3:PutObject on arn:aws:s3:::broadcast-archive-prod/captions/*. Add a Condition with StringEquals on s3:x-amz-server-side-encryption set to aws:kms, so caption files must be written with server-side encryption. The role must also have kms:GenerateDataKey permission on the key in its identity policy. Caption files should share the base name of the video they describe, with the language code appended. Run the job on one program and confirm that both caption formats are written with encryption enabled.

This guide describes the permissions for a subtitle generation job that reads finished videos and writes caption files in the bucket broadcast-archive-prod. Video files are stored under the programs/ prefix, and the job emits WebVTT and SRT files under the captions/ prefix. Edit the bucket policy and add an Allow statement whose Principal is the service principal captionworks.amazonaws.com. Grant s3:GetObject on arn:aws:s3:::broadcast-archive-prod/programs/* and s3:PutObject on arn:aws:s3:::broadcast-archive-prod/captions/*. Add a Condition with StringEquals on s3:x-amz-server-side-encryption set to aws:kms, so caption files must be written with server-side encryption, and scope the statement with aws:SourceAccount set to 888899990000. The service's job configuration must reference the encryption key, and the key policy must separately allow the service principal. Caption files should share the base name of the video they describe, with the language code appended. Run the job on one programand confirm that both caption formats are written with encryption enabled.

This section covers a watermarking job that reads licensed photographs and writes stamped copies to the bucket stock-photos-prod. Unmarked images are kept under the licensed/ prefix, and the job writes JPEG copies with an overlay under the watermarked/ prefix. Add a statement to the bucket policy with Effect set to Allow. Set Principal to the IAM role arn:aws:iam::333344445555:role/WatermarkExecutorRole. Allow s3:GetObject on arn:aws:s3:::stock-photos-prod/licensed/* and s3:PutObject on arn:aws:s3:::stock-photos-prod/watermarked/*. Add a separate Deny statement for the same role on s3:PutObject outside the watermarked/ prefix, so that originals cannot be overwritten. Role sessions should be named after the job ID, which makes access log entries easier to attribute to a specific run. Process a single image and check that the stamped copy exists under watermarked/ and the original is unchanged.

This section covers a watermarking job that reads licensed photographs and writes stamped copies to the bucket stock-photos-prod. Unmarked images are kept under the licensed/ prefix, and the job writes JPEG copies with an overlay under the watermarked/ prefix. Add a statement to the bucket policy with Effect set to Allow. Set Principal to the service principal markguard.amazonaws.com. Allow s3:GetObject on arn:aws:s3:::stock-photos-prod/licensed/* and s3:PutObject on arn:aws:s3:::stock-photos-prod/watermarked/*. Scope the statement with aws:SourceAccount set to 333344445555 and aws:SourceArn set to arn:aws:markguard:us-east-1:333344445555:task/*, which prevents tasks from other accounts from using it. Requests from the service appear in access logs under the service principal, with the task ARN recorded for each run. Process a single image and check that the stamped copy exists under watermarked/ and the original is unchanged.

This procedure grants a redaction job access to read contracts and write sanitized versions in the bucket hr-documents-prod. Original PDF files are stored under the raw/ prefix, and the job writes copies with personal fields removed under the redacted/ prefix. Open the bucket policy and add an Allow statement. Set Principal to the IAM role arn:aws:iam::666677778888:role/RedactionJobRole. Permit s3:GetObject on arn:aws:s3:::hr-documents-prod/raw/* and s3:PutObject on arn:aws:s3:::hr-documents-prod/redacted/*. Add a Condition with the aws:SecureTransport key set to true, so requests over unencrypted connections are not accepted. Because the raw documents are sensitive, review the role's trust policy to confirm that only the redaction workers can assume it. Submit a test contract and verify that the output under redacted/ contains no personal fields and that the raw object is untouched.

This procedure grants a redaction job access to read contracts and write sanitized versions in the bucket hr-documents-prod. Original PDF files are stored under the raw/ prefix, and the job writes copies with personal fields removed under the redacted/ prefix. Open the bucket policy and add an Allow statement. Set Principal to the service principal redactflow.amazonaws.com. Permit s3:GetObject on arn:aws:s3:::hr-documents-prod/raw/* and s3:PutObject on arn:aws:s3:::hr-documents-prod/redacted/*. Add a Condition with the aws:SecureTransport key set to true, and also match aws:SourceAccount to 666677778888 and aws:SourceArn to arn:aws:redactflow:us-west-2:666677778888:job/*. Because the raw documents are sensitive, review the source ARN pattern to confirm that only redaction jobs in your account match it. Submit a test contract and verify that the output under redacted/ contains no personal fields and that the raw object is untouched.
